'''Koh-Lanta: Nicoya''' was the second season of the [[France|French]] version of ''[[Survivor (TV series)|Survivor]]'', ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. This season took place in [[Costa Rica]] on the island of Nicoya, and was broadcast on [[TF1]] from June 28, 2002 to September 13, 2002 airing on Saturdays and Sundays at 6:55&nbsp;p.m.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.leparisien.fr/seine-et-marne-77/les-confidences-d-amel-finaliste-de-koh-lanta-13-09-2002-2003398024.php | title=Les confidences d'Amel, finaliste de " Koh Lanta " | date=12 September 2002 }}</ref> The two original tribes this season were Tambor and Ventanas. As part of a special twist this season following the evacuation of Xavier in episode two, Jacky who was voted out of the Tambor tribe in the previous episode returned to the game. This season also saw the first tribal swap in the history of ''Koh-Lanta'', in which Bernard and Jacky was sent to the Ventanas tribe.

The winner of this season of ''Koh-Lanta'' was Amel Fatnassi, who took home the prize of €100,000 after winning in a 5-2 jury vote against Nicolas Roy.<ref>{{cite web| url = https://www.purepeople.com/article/koh-lanta-qui-sont-les-anciens-gagnants-et-que-sont-ils-devenus_a391022/1| title = Koh-Lanta : Qui sont les anciens gagnants et que sont-ils devenus ? - Purepeople}}</ref>
